(Currently Amended) 1. A method of providing information regarding a product using a computing device, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.

(Currently Amended) 19. The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier associated with a package, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user to whom the product is to be administered.

(Currently Amended) 23. The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to a role of the user identified by the second unique identifier. 

(Currently Amended) 24. The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for a specific user identified by the unique identifier. 

(Cancelled) 27. A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the computing device further configured to communicate with a network. 

(Original) 26. A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier.
